extraction.Name: Hattie Pourier—Nee Standing Bear
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment for the reason that she did not want to pay taxes, but that she was advised to take it by the Indian Agency, and she, therefore, accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1920, she sold her allotment for $3000.00 cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her seven children are supported by her husband, who is an assistant farmer
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; good health; has seven children; husband is an assistant farmer; has never received any aid from the county or Government; document sworn November 15, 1928
